layout.arrangement: Single centered hierarchy diagram: a red parent box at top-center labeled 'Artificial Intelligence', with two curved red arrows branching down to two child boxes side by side — blue box on the left ('Rule Based (Expert Systems)') and green box on the right ('Data Based (Machine Learning)'). A small yellow circle with the number '2' sits at the top-right corner as a slide number. The whole slide content is framed by a thin dark-red/maroon rectangular border.

visual_elements.description: Three-node hierarchy tree: parent node 'Artificial Intelligence' (dark red rectangle, white bold text) at top; two curved red arrows descend from the bottom-center of the parent, splitting left and right, with arrowheads landing on the top edges of two child rectangles. Left child: dark blue rectangle, white bold text 'Rule Based' on line 1 and '(Expert Systems)' on line 2. Right child: green rectangle, white bold text 'Data Based' on line 1 and '(Machine Learning)' on line 2.

typography_notes: Sans-serif bold white text inside all three colored boxes; parent box text is a single line, child boxes use two lines (main term bold, parenthetical term on second line, same weight). Slide number is small black sans-serif inside the yellow circle.
animation_state: Fully built; no partial reveal evident.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Draw a thin maroon (#8B2A3A) rectangular outline inset ~5% from all slide edges. 3. Top-right corner: draw a small yellow (#F5E97B) circle with thin dark outline; place black text '2' centered inside. 4. Top-center: draw a dark red (#8B0000) filled rectangle (~35% slide width, ~10% height) positioned around 25-40% from the top; add centered white bold sans-serif text 'Artificial Intelligence'. 5. Middle-left: draw a dark blue (#00008B) filled rectangle of similar width, positioned around 50-65% from top, left of center; add two lines of centered white bold text: 'Rule Based' / '(Expert Systems)'. 6. Middle-right: draw a green (#1E7B1E) filled rectangle mirroring the blue one on the right; add two lines of centered white bold text: 'Data Based' / '(Machine Learning)'. 7. Draw two thin red (#CC0000) curved arrows (elbow/arc connectors) starting from the bottom-center of the red box, curving down-left and down-right, with arrowheads ending at the top edges of the blue and green boxes respectively.
